items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The D. Chandler played with Buddy Boehme, with Frankie Abbey, with Buddy. I played a three, three, three job with Buddy, when Buddy went off. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: The D. Chandler played with Buddy Boehme, with Frankie Abbey, with Buddy. I played a three, three, three job with Buddy, when Buddy went off.
